    VeSync Air Fryers↲

    pyvesync supports these Cosori smart air fryers. All of them are in manager.devices.air_fryers after get_devices().

    Model Class Chambers Preheat Pause / resume Unit before first update()
    CS137-AF, CS158-AF (3.7 and 5.8 Qt.) VeSyncAirFryer158 1 ✔ ✔ °F
    CAF-DC601S TurboBlaze 6 Qt. VeSyncTurboBlazeFryer 1 ✔ °F
    CAF-P583S Dual Blaze 6.8 Qt. (KUS, KEU) VeSyncDualBlazeFryer 1 °F (KUS), °C (KEU)
    CAF-TF101S Dual Air Fryer VeSyncDualAirFryer 1, 2, whole, both °C
    CAF-DC111S-AEU Turbo Tower Pro VeSyncDualAirFryer 1 (upper), 2 (lower), both °C

    The CAF-TF102S uses VeSyncDualAirFryer and the same chambers, without the Dry mode. Its mapping comes from the VeSync app and is pending hardware verification. The CAF-P583S KEU has no packet capture; it is assumed to match the KUS apart from its Celsius unit. The CAF-DC111S-AEU mapping comes from the VeSync app and the status captures supplied with PR #536; its cook and end requests are pending hardware verification.

    Every fryer has set_mode(), set_mode_from_recipe(), end() and update(). stop(), resume() and cook_from_preheat() are only implemented for the CS137/CS158; on the other fryers they log a message and return False without sending a request. Air fryers have no on/off command and no turn_on() / turn_off(); the CS137/CS158 toggle_switch() is deprecated and sends no request.

    Quick start↲

    import asyncio
from pyvesync import VeSync


async def main():
    async with VeSync(username="EMAIL", password="PASSWORD") as manager:
        await manager.login()
        await manager.get_devices()

        fryer = manager.devices.air_fryers[0]
        await fryer.update()
        print(fryer.state.cook_status, fryer.temp_unit)

        # Cook for 15 minutes at 400 °F (converted on Celsius fryers)
        if await fryer.set_mode(15 * 60, 400, temp_unit='f'):
            print(fryer.state.cook_time_remaining)

        await fryer.end()


asyncio.run(main())

    Every control method returns True when the device accepted the command and False otherwise. A rejected argument (unsupported chamber, cook mode, temperature, time or unit) returns False before any request is sent, with a log message saying why. The control methods and update() log problems rather than raising them.

    A failed or unreadable update() (no response, an error code, an unknown cook status, an out-of-range step) logs a message and leaves the chamber state as it was, so a command afterwards still sees the last known phase. On the dual-chamber fryers (CAF-TF101S/TF102S, CAF-DC111S-AEU) both chambers take the connection status and update time from the response, and a chamber with an unknown status keeps its state. A reported temperature unit pyvesync does not recognise is logged and the current unit kept.

    A command the fryer refuses returns False and leaves the state as it was; fryer.last_response names the reason. For example, the CAF-DC111S-AEU can refuse a Sync cook (chamber=BOTH) with BYPASS_SYNC_FINISH_FAIL_1 (open the other basket), BYPASS_SYNC_FINISH_FAIL_2 (reduce the cooking time of the current basket) or BYPASS_AVATAR_SYNC_FAIL (Sync cannot start while cooking).

    Cooking↲

    await fryer.set_mode(cook_time, cook_temp, *, temp_unit=None,
                     preheat_time=None, cook_mode=None, chamber=CHAMBER_1)
    • cook_time and preheat_time are in seconds, as whole numbers (a fraction is dropped). cook_time must be at least 1 second. The CS137/CS158 API counts in whole minutes, so pyvesync rounds the time down to the minute (90 s is sent as 1 minute) and rejects a cook_time under 60 s. There is no upper limit: pyvesync does not check the app's per-mode time ranges (for example 1-60 minutes for most modes), so a longer time is sent as given and the fryer may refuse it.
    • cook_temp is in the fryer's temp_unit, or in temp_unit if you pass one (see Temperature units).
    • With no cook_mode, the fryer's default preset is used: Manual Cooking on the CS137/CS158 and Air Fry on the others. Only the preset's mode, recipe ID, name and type are sent; the time and temperature are yours. See Cook modes for the other modes.
    • The temperature is rounded to the nearest step of the mode, never rejected for being off-step, and then checked against the mode's range (see Temperature limits).
    • preheat_time starts a preheat phase on fryers with preheat. There it must be 0 (no preheat) or at least one API time unit: 1 second, or 60 seconds on the CS137/CS158, which also rounds it down to whole minutes. A negative or shorter time returns False without a request. The CAF-P583S and the dual-chamber fryers (CAF-TF101S/TF102S, CAF-DC111S-AEU) have no preheat and drop it (with a debug log).
    • pyvesync sends readyStart false. The CS137/CS158 capture shows the cook then starts at once, without the start button; the other models are assumed to behave the same.

    After a successful command the chamber's state is set from the request (status, set time, remaining time, temperature and mode), and the remaining times count down locally. The next update() replaces them with what the device reports.

    Recipes↲

    get_mode_recipe(cook_mode) returns a cook mode's preset at the VeSync app's default time and temperature, as an AirFryerPresetRecipe, or None if the fryer has no such mode. Pass it to set_mode_from_recipe(), changing the time, temperature or preheat first if needed:

    from dataclasses import replace
from pyvesync.const import AirFryerCookModes

recipe = fryer.get_mode_recipe(AirFryerCookModes.ROAST)
if recipe is not None:
    recipe = replace(recipe, cook_time=25 * 60, preheat_time=3 * 60)
    await fryer.set_mode_from_recipe(recipe)

    AirFryerPresetRecipe holds recipe_name, cook_mode, recipe_id, recipe_type, target_temp, temp_unit ('f' or 'c'), cook_time and preheat_time (both in seconds; preheat_time is optional). The recipe's temperature is converted to the fryer's unit if needed, rounded and checked against the limits of the recipe's cook_mode. The times are checked as for set_mode(). The recipe's cook_mode must be one of the fryer's modes (see Cook modes); otherwise the method returns False without a request. Its mode, ID, name and type are sent as given, so start from get_mode_recipe() rather than inventing them. cook_mode is the API mode string ('AirFry', 'poultry') or an AirFryerCookModes key; the API mode string is what is sent. A recipe temp_unit that does not start with c or f returns False without a request.

    fryer.default_preset is the recipe set_mode() copies when no cook_mode is given. Each fryer has its own copy, so changing it affects only that fryer. Its own time and temperature are pyvesync defaults and can differ from get_mode_recipe() for the same mode; use get_mode_recipe() for the app's defaults.

    Controlling a cook↲

    Method What it does Fryers
    end(chamber) Ends the cook or preheat and returns the chamber to standby. All
    stop(chamber) Pauses the cook or preheat. CS137/CS158
    resume(chamber) Resumes a paused cook or preheat. CS137/CS158
    cook_from_preheat(chamber) Starts the cook once preheat has finished (PREHEAT_END). CS137/CS158

    On the CS137/CS158, end(), stop() and resume() use the last known status (from update() or the last successful command) to choose between the cook and preheat commands. Paused, basket-out and preheat-finished count as in a phase.

    • stop() and resume() are always sent: the preheat command during a preheat phase, otherwise the cook command (also in standby). They don't check whether the fryer is already paused or running.
    • end() returns False without a request when the fryer is in neither a cook nor a preheat phase (standby, or APPOINTING, so a scheduled cook cannot be cancelled).
    • Every successful command sets the state to the phase it sent (stop() gives COOK_STOP or PREHEAT_STOP, resume() gives COOKING or HEATING), so the next command picks the matching one without an update(). The remaining time carries over, so resume() while running does not restart the countdown.

    Call update() first if the fryer may have changed state on its own.

    The dual-chamber fryers have no pause command. Their status maps have cookStop and pullOut; per the app's behaviour, pulling a basket out pauses that chamber and pushing it back in resumes it. The CAF-DC111S-AEU captures report both statuses during a cook, with the remaining time held; no TF101S capture of them exists yet.

    Reading status↲

    update() polls the device. Single-chamber fryers keep their status in fryer.state; dual-chamber fryers have state_chamber_1 and state_chamber_2 (state is state_chamber_1), and get_chamber_state() returns the state for one chamber. All times are in seconds and all temperatures in the fryer's temp_unit.

    Attribute Meaning
    cook_status An AirFryerCookStatus member (see below).
    cook_mode, recipe The API mode string and recipe name of the current or last cook (cook_mode is kept in standby). After a local command, recipe is set only on the dual-chamber fryers; the other fryers fill it on update().
    cook_set_temp, current_temp The set and measured temperatures. The dual-chamber fryers' status has no measured-temperature field, so current_temp stays None.
    cook_set_time, preheat_set_time The set cook and preheat times.
    cook_time_remaining, preheat_time_remaining Remaining cook and preheat time, counting down from the last update while running (and during HOLD while the other chamber cooks, where cook_time_remaining is the wait before the chamber starts). None outside that phase.
    total_time_remaining Time until the cook finishes, preheat included. None in standby, and on the CS137/CS158 during preheat once an update() has run (that fryer reports no cook time then).
    is_cooking, is_preheating, is_running is_cooking is True in COOKING, is_preheating in HEATING, is_running in either.
    is_in_cook_mode, is_in_preheat_mode True in any cook or preheat status, running or not (for example COOK_STOP, COOK_END, PREHEAT_END), and with the basket out during that phase.
    can_resume True when paused (COOK_STOP or PREHEAT_STOP).

    AirFryerCookStatus values (from pyvesync.const). Not every fryer reports every status:

    Member Meaning
    STANDBY Idle.
    HEATING Preheating.
    PREHEAT_STOP Preheat paused.
    PREHEAT_END Preheat finished, waiting for cook_from_preheat() (CS137/CS158).
    COOKING Cooking.
    COOK_STOP Cook paused.
    PULL_OUT Basket pulled out.
    COOK_END Cook finished.
    READY Set up and waiting to start on the fryer.
    APPOINTING Waiting for a delayed start set in the app (CS137/CS158). pyvesync cannot set one.
    HOLD Sync cook with different times: this chamber waits so both finish together (CAF-DC111S-AEU). cook_time_remaining is the wait and total_time_remaining includes the cook; both count down only while the other chamber is cooking, and stop while it is paused. Counts as cook mode; is_running is False. pyvesync's BOTH sends the same settings to both chambers, so only a Sync cook started in the app or on the fryer reports it.

    The CAF-P583S status map maps keeping (keep-warm) to COOKING; no capture of it exists yet. COMPLETED and UNKNOWN are in the enum but no supported fryer reports them.

    Each state's to_dict() / to_json() gives all of these values at once.

    Chambers↲

    Every fryer method that targets a basket takes a chamber argument, an AirFryerChamber member (from pyvesync.const) or its integer value. The values match the API's workChamber / chamber fields.

    Member Value Meaning
    CHAMBER_1 1 Chamber 1 (left; upper on the CAF-DC111S-AEU). The default, and the only chamber on single-basket fryers.
    CHAMBER_2 2 Chamber 2 (right; lower on the CAF-DC111S-AEU). Dual-chamber fryers only.
    WHOLE 3 The merged basket with the divider removed. CAF-TF101S/TF102S only (WHOLE_CHAMBER feature).
    BOTH 4 Both chambers with the same settings, sent as the app's Sync mode (both chambers finish together). Dual-chamber fryers only.

    supported_chambers lists the chambers a fryer accepts, and is_dual_chamber is True for dual-basket models.

    On a dual-chamber fryer:

    from pyvesync.const import AirFryerChamber

await fryer.set_mode(600, 200, chamber=AirFryerChamber.CHAMBER_2)
await fryer.set_mode_from_recipe(recipe, chamber=AirFryerChamber.BOTH)
await fryer.end(AirFryerChamber.BOTH)

await fryer.update()
chamber_state = fryer.get_chamber_state(AirFryerChamber.CHAMBER_2)
if chamber_state is not None:
    remaining = chamber_state.cook_time_remaining

    A chamber the fryer does not support makes the method return False without sending a request. get_chamber_state() returns None (with a debug log) for BOTH, which names two states (read state_chamber_1 and state_chamber_2 instead), and for a chamber the fryer does not support.

    sync_chambers and work_chamber are read-only. update() sets both from the device; sync_chambers is also set by a successful start or end(BOTH). They are the same on the fryer and on both chamber states, and on single-chamber fryers they are always False and None.

    • sync_chambers is True only when the device reports the app's Sync mode (both chambers finish together). The app's Match mode reports False. A successful set_mode() or set_mode_from_recipe() also sets it (True for BOTH, False otherwise), and end(BOTH) clears it.
    • work_chamber is the chamber the device reports as active. It is None when the fryer is idle, and always None on single-chamber fryers. Besides update(), a successful WHOLE start sets it to WHOLE, any other start clears a WHOLE value, and a successful end(WHOLE) or end(BOTH) clears it.

    To cook both chambers, pass chamber=AirFryerChamber.BOTH. During a Sync cook, end() with one chamber sends an end for that chamber only; use end(AirFryerChamber.BOTH) to end both. During a whole-basket cook (work_chamber is WHOLE), end() with the default CHAMBER_1 ends the whole basket.

    Cook modes↲

    cook_modes lists each fryer's presets from the VeSync app, keyed by AirFryerCookModes (from pyvesync.const). Each entry holds the mode string the API uses, the preset's recipe ID and name, its default time and temperatures, and its temperature limits. get_cook_mode() looks one up by key or by API mode string.

    Fryer Modes
    CS137/CS158 CUSTOM (Manual Cooking, the default), STEAK, CHICKEN, SEAFOOD, BACON, VEGETABLES, ROOT_VEGETABLES, FROZEN, DESSERTS, SHRIMP, BREAD, FRENCH_FRIES
    CAF-DC601S AIRFRY (default), ROAST, BROIL, FROZEN, REHEAT, BAKE, DRY, PROOF, WARM
    CAF-P583S AIRFRY (default), BROIL, ROAST, BAKE, CHICKEN, STEAK, SEAFOOD, VEGETABLES, FRENCH_FRIES, FROZEN, REHEAT
    CAF-TF101S AIRFRY (default), ROAST, BAKE, GRILL, REHEAT, DRY
    CAF-TF102S AIRFRY (default), ROAST, BAKE, GRILL, REHEAT
    CAF-DC111S-AEU AIRFRY (default), BAKE, ROAST, GRILL, REHEAT, DRY, PROOF

    set_mode(..., cook_mode=...) accepts an AirFryerCookModes key or the API mode string, and sends that preset's recipe ID, name and type. With no cook_mode it sends the fryer's default preset. set_mode(cook_mode=...) with a mode the fryer does not have returns False without sending a request.

    set_mode_from_recipe() sends the recipe's own cook_mode and checks its temperature against that mode's limits, or the default mode's limits if the fryer has no such mode.

    from pyvesync.const import AirFryerCookModes

# Bake exists on the CAF-DC601S, CAF-P583S, CAF-TF101S/TF102S and CAF-DC111S-AEU
await fryer.set_mode(1200, 330, temp_unit='f', cook_mode=AirFryerCookModes.BAKE)

# The preset at its app defaults, for set_mode_from_recipe()
recipe = fryer.get_mode_recipe(AirFryerCookModes.BAKE)
if recipe is not None:
    await fryer.set_mode_from_recipe(recipe)

    Temperature limits↲

    Each cook mode has its own temperature range and step in both Celsius and Fahrenheit, taken from the VeSync app. temp_limits(cook_mode) returns them in the fryer's current temp_unit; with no mode, or a mode the fryer does not have, it returns the default mode's limits.

    limits = fryer.temp_limits('Grill')  # CAF-TF101S/TF102S Grill
print(limits.min_temp, limits.max_temp, limits.step)

    A requested temperature is rounded to the nearest multiple of its mode's step, then checked against its mode's range. Off-step temperatures are always rounded, never rejected. Rounding uses Python's round(), so a value exactly halfway between two steps goes to the even multiple: with a 10° step, 395 becomes 400 but 385 becomes 380. A temperature outside the range makes the method return False without sending a request.

    min_temp and max_temp are the widest span across all of the fryer's modes, for display. A temperature inside that span can still be outside the range of the mode you cook with; check temp_limits(cook_mode) before calling set_mode(). temperature_step is the default mode's step.

    Only temperatures have per-mode limits. Cook times are checked only for the minimum described under Cooking.

    Temperature units↲

    The fryer's temp_unit comes from each update(). Before the first update it is the device map's default for that model or region. Temperatures in the state, and cook_temp passed to set_mode(), are in this unit.

    Pass temp_unit to give cook_temp in another unit; pyvesync converts it to the device unit before sending:

    await fryer.set_mode(600, 390, temp_unit='f')  # sent as 200 C on a Celsius fryer

    temp_unit accepts a TemperatureUnits member or a string starting with c or f ('c', 'celsius', 'F', ...). Any other string makes the method return False without sending a request.

    A unit changed on the device between update() and a command is not detected; call update() first if the unit may have changed.

    pyvesync converts with the formula (TemperatureUnits.to_celsius / to_fahrenheit) and then rounds to the cook mode's step. The VeSync app instead pairs each mode's Celsius and Fahrenheit lists by position, so a converted temperature can be one step away from what the app shows for the same input. Pass cook_temp in the device's own unit to avoid conversion.

    API reference↲

    pyvesync.devices.vesynckitchen ↲

    VeSync Cosori air fryers.

    • VeSyncAirFryer158: CS137/CS158 (Bypass V1 API, times in minutes).
    • VeSyncTurboBlazeFryer: CAF-DC601S (bypassV2 startCook).
    • VeSyncDualBlazeFryer: CAF-P583S (bypassV2 startCook).
    • VeSyncDualAirFryer: CAF-TF101S / CAF-TF102S / CAF-DC111S (bypassV2 startMultiCook, two chambers).

    A successful command sets the chamber state locally from the request; it does not call update(). Call update() to read what the device reports. A failed or unreadable poll logs and leaves the state unchanged. The CS137/CS158 end(), stop(), resume() and cook_from_preheat() choose the cook or preheat command from the last known state, which every successful command keeps in the phase it sent.

    pyvesync.devices.vesynckitchen.VeSyncAirFryer158 ↲

    Bases: VeSyncFryer

    Cosori CS137/CS158 air fryer (Bypass V1 API).

    The API counts time in whole minutes, so times are truncated to the minute when sent, and a cook time under 60 seconds is rejected. This is the only fryer class that implements stop(), resume() and cook_from_preheat(). They and end() choose the cook or preheat command from the last known state. stop() and resume() are sent in any state (the cook command when not preheating), and every successful command sets the state to the phase it sent, so the next command matches. A device whose config module is not in AIRFRYER_PID_MAP raises VeSyncError, and the device container skips it with a warning.

    class VeSyncAirFryer158(VeSyncFryer):
    """Cosori CS137/CS158 air fryer (Bypass V1 API).

    The API counts time in whole minutes, so times are truncated to the minute
    when sent, and a cook time under 60 seconds is rejected. This is the only
    fryer class that implements ``stop()``, ``resume()`` and
    ``cook_from_preheat()``. They and ``end()`` choose the cook or preheat
    command from the last known state. ``stop()`` and ``resume()`` are sent in
    any state (the cook command when not preheating), and every successful
    command sets the state to the phase it sent, so the next command matches.
    A device whose config module is not in ``AIRFRYER_PID_MAP`` raises
    ``VeSyncError``, and the device container skips it with a warning.

    Args:
        details (ResponseDeviceDetailsModel): Device details.
        manager (VeSync): Manager class.
        feature_map (AirFryerMap): Device feature map.

    Attributes:
        pid (str): Product ID from ``AIRFRYER_PID_MAP``, by config module.
        request_keys (tuple[str, ...]): Keys copied into every request body.
        last_response (ResponseInfo): Last response from API call.
        manager (VeSync): Manager object for API calls.
        device_name (str): Name of device.
        device_image (str): URL for device image.
        cid (str): Device ID.
        connection_type (str): Connection type of device.
        device_type (str): Type of device.
        type (str): Type of device.
        uuid (str): UUID of device, not always present.
        config_module (str): Configuration module of device.
        mac_id (str): MAC ID of device.
        current_firm_version (str): Current firmware version of device.
        device_region (str): Region of device. (US, EU, etc.)
        sub_device_no (int): Sub-device number of device.
        product_type (str): Product type of device.
    """

    __slots__ = (
        'last_update',
        'ready_start',
        'refresh_interval',
    )

    request_keys: tuple[str, ...] = (
        'acceptLanguage',
        'appVersion',
        'phoneBrand',
        'phoneOS',
        'accountID',
        'cid',
        'configModule',
        'debugMode',
        'traceId',
        'timeZone',
        'token',
        'userCountryCode',
        'uuid',
        'pid',
    )

    def __init__(
        self,
        details: ResponseDeviceDetailsModel,
        manager: VeSync,
        feature_map: AirFryerMap,
    ) -> None:
        """Init the VeSync Air Fryer 158 class."""
        super().__init__(details, manager, feature_map)
        self.features: list[str] = feature_map.features
        self.ready_start = False
        if self.config_module not in AIRFRYER_PID_MAP:
            msg = (
                'Report this error as an issue - '
                f'{self.config_module} not found in PID map for {self.device_type}'
            )
            raise VeSyncError(msg)
        self.pid = AIRFRYER_PID_MAP[self.config_module]

    @deprecated('There is no on/off function for Air Fryers.')
    async def toggle_switch(self, toggle: bool | None = None) -> bool:
        """Do nothing; air fryers have no on/off command.

        No request is sent.

        Returns:
            bool: ``toggle``, or ``not is_on`` when ``toggle`` is None.
        """
        return toggle if toggle is not None else not self.is_on

    def _build_158_request(
        self,
        request_model: type[models.Fryer158RequestModel],
        update_dict: dict | None = None,
        method: str = 'bypass',
    ) -> models.Fryer158RequestModel:
        """Build API request body for the Bypass V1 endpoint.

        Args:
            request_model (type[models.Fryer158RequestModel]): The request model to use.
            update_dict (dict | None): Additional keys to add on.
            method (str): The method to use in the outer body, defaults to bypass.

        Returns:
            models.Fryer158RequestModel: The request body built from
            ``request_model``.
        """
        body = Helpers.get_defaultvalues_attributes(self.request_keys).copy()
        body.update(Helpers.get_manager_attributes(self.manager, self.request_keys))
        body.update(Helpers.get_device_attributes(self, self.request_keys))
        body['method'] = method
        body.update(update_dict or {})
        return request_model.from_dict(body)

    async def call_158_api(
        self,
        request_model: type[models.Fryer158RequestModel],
        update_dict: dict | None = None,
        method: str = 'bypass',
        endpoint: str = 'bypass',
    ) -> dict | None:
        """Send a Cosori 158 API request.

        This uses the `_build_158_request` method to send API requests
        to the Cosori 158 API.

        Args:
            request_model (type[models.Fryer158RequestModel]): The request model to use.
            update_dict (dict | None): Additional keys to add on.
            method (str): The method to use in the outer body.
            endpoint (str): The last part of the url path, defaults to
                `bypass`, e.g. `/cloud/v1/deviceManaged/bypass`.

        Returns:
            dict | None: The response JSON, or None if there was no valid
            response.
        """
        request = self._build_158_request(request_model, update_dict, method)
        url_path = BYPASS_V1_PATH + endpoint
        resp_dict, _ = await self.manager.async_call_api(
            url_path, 'post', request, Helpers.req_header_bypass()
        )

        return resp_dict

    def _build_base_request(
        self, cook_set_time: int, recipe: AirFryerPresetRecipe | None = None
    ) -> dict[str, int | str | bool]:
        """Build base cook or preheat request body.

        This allows a custom recipe to be passed, but defaults to manual
        cooking. The cook_set_time argument is required and will override
        the default time in the recipe.
        """
        cook_base: dict[str, int | str | bool] = {}
        cook_base['cookSetTime'] = cook_set_time
        if recipe is None:
            cook_base['recipeId'] = self.default_preset.recipe_id
            cook_base['customRecipe'] = self.default_preset.recipe_name
            cook_base['mode'] = self.default_preset.cook_mode
            cook_base['recipeType'] = self.default_preset.recipe_type
        else:
            cook_base['recipeId'] = recipe.recipe_id
            cook_base['customRecipe'] = recipe.recipe_name
            cook_base['mode'] = recipe.cook_mode
            cook_base['recipeType'] = recipe.recipe_type

        cook_base['accountId'] = self.manager.account_id
        cook_base['tempUnit'] = self.temp_unit.label
        # readyStart False starts the cook at once; True waits for the start button.
        cook_base['readyStart'] = False
        return cook_base

    def _build_cook_request(
        self,
        cook_time: int,
        cook_temp: int,
        recipe: AirFryerPresetRecipe | None = None,
    ) -> dict[str, int | str | bool]:
        """Internal command to build cookMode API command."""
        cook_mode = self._build_base_request(cook_time, recipe)
        cook_mode['appointmentTs'] = 0
        cook_mode['cookSetTemp'] = cook_temp
        cook_mode['cookStatus'] = AirFryer158Command.COOKING
        return cook_mode

    def _build_preheat_request(
        self,
        cook_time: int,
        preheat_time: int,
        cook_temp: int,
        recipe: AirFryerPresetRecipe | None = None,
    ) -> dict[str, int | str | bool]:
        """Internal command to build preheat API command.

        Both times are in the device's API time units.
        """
        preheat_mode = self._build_base_request(cook_time, recipe)
        preheat_mode['targetTemp'] = cook_temp
        preheat_mode['preheatSetTime'] = preheat_time
        preheat_mode['preheatStatus'] = AirFryer158Command.HEATING
        return preheat_mode

    async def get_details(self) -> None:
        cmd = {'getStatus': 'status'}
        jsoncmd = {'jsonCmd': cmd}
        resp = await self.call_158_api(models.Fryer158RequestModel, update_dict=jsoncmd)

        if not isinstance(resp, dict) or 'result' not in resp:
            logger.debug(
                'Invalid response for get_details for %s: %s', self.device_name, resp
            )
            self.state.connection_status = ConnectionStatus.OFFLINE
            return None
        if not isinstance(resp['result'], dict):
            logger.debug(
                'No result in get_details response for %s: %s', self.device_name, resp
            )
            return None

        resp_model = process_bypassv1_result(
            self,
            logger,
            'get_details',
            resp,
            models.Fryer158Result,
        )

        if resp_model is None or resp_model.returnStatus is None:
            logger.debug(
                'No returnStatus in get_details response for %s', self.device_name
            )
            return None

        return_status = resp_model.returnStatus
        if return_status.cookStatus not in self.status_map:
            logger.warning(
                'Unknown cook status %s for %s, keeping the last state',
                return_status.cookStatus,
                self.device_name,
            )
            return None
        if return_status.tempUnit is not None:
            self.temp_unit = return_status.tempUnit
        return self.state.set_state(
            cook_status=self.status_map[return_status.cookStatus],
            cook_time=return_status.cookSetTime,
            cook_last_time=return_status.cookLastTime,
            # Preheat and pull-out-during-preheat states report targetTemp only.
            cook_temp=return_status.cookSetTemp
            if return_status.cookSetTemp is not None
            else return_status.targetTemp,
            cook_mode=return_status.mode,
            preheat_set_time=return_status.preheatSetTime,
            preheat_last_time=return_status.preheatLastTime,
            current_temp=return_status.current_temp,
            recipe=return_status.customRecipe,
        )

    async def end(
        self, chamber: AirFryerChamber | int = AirFryerChamber.CHAMBER_1
    ) -> bool:
        if self._validate_chamber(chamber) is None:
            return False
        if self.state.is_in_cook_mode is True:
            preheat = False
        elif self.state.is_in_preheat_mode is True:
            preheat = True
        else:
            logger.debug(
                'Cannot end %s as it is not cooking or preheating', self.device_name
            )
            return False
        if not await self._send_phase_command('end', AirFryer158Command.END, preheat):
            return False
        self.state.set_standby()
        return True

    async def _send_phase_command(
        self, method_name: str, command: AirFryer158Command, preheat: bool
    ) -> bool:
        """Send a ``preheatStatus`` or ``cookStatus`` change command.

        Args:
            method_name (str): Calling method, for the logs.
            command (AirFryer158Command): The status value to send.
            preheat (bool): True for the ``preheat`` command, False for
                ``cookMode``.

        Returns:
            bool: True if the device accepted the command.
        """
        if preheat:
            cmd = {'preheat': {'preheatStatus': command}}
        else:
            cmd = {'cookMode': {'cookStatus': command}}
        resp = await self.call_158_api(
            models.Fryer158RequestModel, update_dict={'jsonCmd': cmd}
        )
        return Helpers.process_dev_response(logger, method_name, self, resp) is not None

    async def stop(
        self, chamber: AirFryerChamber | int = AirFryerChamber.CHAMBER_1
    ) -> bool:
        if self._validate_chamber(chamber) is None:
            return False
        preheat = self.state.is_in_preheat_mode
        if not await self._send_phase_command('stop', AirFryer158Command.STOP, preheat):
            return False
        if preheat:
            self.state.set_preheat_stop_state()
        else:
            self.state.set_cook_stop_state()
        return True

    async def resume(
        self, chamber: AirFryerChamber | int = AirFryerChamber.CHAMBER_1
    ) -> bool:
        if self._validate_chamber(chamber) is None:
            return False
        preheat = self.state.is_in_preheat_mode
        command = AirFryer158Command.HEATING if preheat else AirFryer158Command.COOKING
        if not await self._send_phase_command('resume', command, preheat):
            return False
        if preheat:
            self.state.set_preheat_resume_state()
        else:
            self.state.set_cook_resume_state()
        return True

    async def set_mode_from_recipe(
        self,
        recipe: AirFryerPresetRecipe,
        *,
        chamber: AirFryerChamber | int = AirFryerChamber.CHAMBER_1,
    ) -> bool:
        if self._validate_chamber(chamber) is None:
            return False
        prepared = self._prepare_recipe(recipe)
        if prepared is None:
            return False
        recipe = prepared
        cook_time = self.convert_time_for_api(recipe.cook_time)
        preheat_time = (
            self.convert_time_for_api(recipe.preheat_time)
            if recipe.preheat_time is not None
            else None
        )
        if preheat_time is not None and preheat_time > 0:
            cook_status = AirFryerCookStatus.HEATING
            preheat_req = self._build_preheat_request(
                cook_time=cook_time,
                preheat_time=preheat_time,
                cook_temp=recipe.target_temp,
                recipe=recipe,
            )
            cmd = {'preheat': preheat_req}
        else:
            cook_status = AirFryerCookStatus.COOKING
            cook_req = self._build_cook_request(
                cook_time=cook_time, cook_temp=recipe.target_temp, recipe=recipe
            )
            cmd = {'cookMode': cook_req}
        json_cmd = {'jsonCmd': cmd}
        resp = await self.call_158_api(models.Fryer158RequestModel, update_dict=json_cmd)
        r = Helpers.process_dev_response(logger, 'set_mode_from_recipe', self, resp)
        if r is None:
            return False
        self.state.set_state(
            cook_status=cook_status,
            cook_time=cook_time,
            cook_last_time=cook_time,
            cook_temp=recipe.target_temp,
            cook_mode=recipe.cook_mode,
            preheat_set_time=preheat_time,
            preheat_last_time=preheat_time,
        )
        return True

    async def set_mode(
        self,
        cook_time: int,
        cook_temp: int,
        *,
        temp_unit: TemperatureUnits | str | None = None,
        preheat_time: int | None = None,
        cook_mode: str | None = None,
        chamber: AirFryerChamber | int = AirFryerChamber.CHAMBER_1,
    ) -> bool:
        unit = self._resolve_temp_unit(temp_unit)
        if unit is None:
            return False
        recipe = self._recipe_for_set_mode(
            cook_time, cook_temp, cook_mode, preheat_time, temp_unit=unit
        )
        if recipe is None:
            return False
        return await self.set_mode_from_recipe(recipe, chamber=chamber)

    async def cook_from_preheat(
        self, chamber: AirFryerChamber | int = AirFryerChamber.CHAMBER_1
    ) -> bool:
        if self._validate_chamber(chamber) is None:
            return False
        if self.state.cook_status != AirFryerCookStatus.PREHEAT_END:
            logger.debug('Cannot start cook from preheat for %s', self.device_name)
            return False
        cmd = {
            'cookMode': {
                'mode': self.state.cook_mode,
                'accountId': self.manager.account_id,
                'cookStatus': AirFryer158Command.COOKING,
                'tempUnit': self.temp_unit.label,
            }
        }
        json_cmd = {'jsonCmd': cmd}
        resp = await self.call_158_api(models.Fryer158RequestModel, update_dict=json_cmd)
        r = Helpers.process_dev_response(logger, 'cook_from_preheat', self, resp)
        if r is None:
            return False
        self.state.set_state(cook_status=AirFryerCookStatus.COOKING)
        return True

    end async ↲

    end(chamber: AirFryerChamber | int = CHAMBER_1) -> bool

    Inherited From VeSyncFryer

    End the current cooking or preheating session.

    On success the chamber state is set to standby. On the CS137/CS158 the command depends on the last known state, and it returns False without a request when that state is neither cooking nor preheating. On the CAF-TF101S/TF102S, CHAMBER_1 during a whole-basket cook (work_chamber WHOLE) ends the whole basket.

    Parameters:

    async def end(
    self, chamber: AirFryerChamber | int = AirFryerChamber.CHAMBER_1
) -> bool:
    if self._validate_chamber(chamber) is None:
        return False
    if self.state.is_in_cook_mode is True:
        preheat = False
    elif self.state.is_in_preheat_mode is True:
        preheat = True
    else:
        logger.debug(
            'Cannot end %s as it is not cooking or preheating', self.device_name
        )
        return False
    if not await self._send_phase_command('end', AirFryer158Command.END, preheat):
        return False
    self.state.set_standby()
    return True

    async def stop(
    self, chamber: AirFryerChamber | int = AirFryerChamber.CHAMBER_1
) -> bool:
    if self._validate_chamber(chamber) is None:
        return False
    preheat = self.state.is_in_preheat_mode
    if not await self._send_phase_command('stop', AirFryer158Command.STOP, preheat):
        return False
    if preheat:
        self.state.set_preheat_stop_state()
    else:
        self.state.set_cook_stop_state()
    return True

    async def resume(
    self, chamber: AirFryerChamber | int = AirFryerChamber.CHAMBER_1
) -> bool:
    if self._validate_chamber(chamber) is None:
        return False
    preheat = self.state.is_in_preheat_mode
    command = AirFryer158Command.HEATING if preheat else AirFryer158Command.COOKING
    if not await self._send_phase_command('resume', command, preheat):

    async def set_mode_from_recipe(
    self,
    recipe: AirFryerPresetRecipe,
    *,
    chamber: AirFryerChamber | int = AirFryerChamber.CHAMBER_1,
) -> bool:
    if self._validate_chamber(chamber) is None:
        return False
    prepared = self._prepare_recipe(recipe)
    if prepared is None:
        return False
    recipe = prepared
    cook_time = self.convert_time_for_api(recipe.cook_time)
    preheat_time = (
        self.convert_time_for_api(recipe.preheat_time)
        if recipe.preheat_time is not None
        else None
    )
    if preheat_time is not None and preheat_time > 0:
        cook_status = AirFryerCookStatus.HEATING
        preheat_req = self._build_preheat_request(
            cook_time=cook_time,
            preheat_time=preheat_time,
            cook_temp=recipe.target_temp,
            recipe=recipe,
        )
        cmd = {'preheat': preheat_req}
    else:
        cook_status = AirFryerCookStatus.COOKING
        cook_req = self._build_cook_request(
            cook_time=cook_time, cook_temp=recipe.target_temp, recipe=recipe
        )
        cmd = {'cookMode': cook_req}
    json_cmd = {'jsonCmd': cmd}
    resp = await self.call_158_api(models.Fryer158RequestModel, update_dict=json_cmd)
    r = Helpers.process_dev_response(logger, 'set_mode_from_recipe', self, resp)
    if r is None:
        return False
    self.state.set_state(
        cook_status=cook_status,
        cook_time=cook_time,
        cook_last_time=cook_time,
        cook_temp=recipe.target_temp,
        cook_mode=recipe.cook_mode,
        preheat_set_time=preheat_time,
        preheat_last_time=preheat_time,
    )
    return True

    async def cook_from_preheat(
    self, chamber: AirFryerChamber | int = AirFryerChamber.CHAMBER_1
) -> bool:
    if self._validate_chamber(chamber) is None:
        return False
    if self.state.cook_status != AirFryerCookStatus.PREHEAT_END:
        logger.debug('Cannot start cook from preheat for %s', self.device_name)
        return False
    cmd = {
        'cookMode': {
            'mode': self.state.cook_mode,
            'accountId': self.manager.account_id,
            'cookStatus': AirFryer158Command.COOKING,
            'tempUnit': self.temp_unit.label,
        }
    }
    json_cmd = {'jsonCmd': cmd}
    resp = await self.call_158_api(models.Fryer158RequestModel, update_dict=json_cmd)
    r = Helpers.process_dev_response(logger, 'cook_from_preheat', self, resp)
    if r is None:
        return False
    self.state.set_state(cook_status=AirFryerCookStatus.COOKING)
    return True

    class VeSyncTurboBlazeFryer(BypassV2Mixin, VeSyncFryer):
    """Cosori TurboBlaze air fryer (CAF-DC601S, bypassV2 ``startCook``).

    Single chamber; times are in seconds. A preheat is sent only when the
    device map has the ``PREHEAT`` feature, otherwise ``preheat_time`` is
    dropped with a debug log. ``stop()``, ``resume()`` and
    ``cook_from_preheat()`` are not implemented and return False. The reported
    ``currentTemp`` is in Celsius and is converted to ``temp_unit``. A local
    ``set_mode()`` does not set ``state.recipe``. A failed poll, an unknown
    ``cookStatus`` or an out-of-range ``stepIndex`` leaves the state unchanged.
    """

    __slots__ = ()

    def _payload_update(self) -> dict | None:
        """Return extra payload keys sent on every request, if any."""
        return None

    def _cook_request_dict(
        self, recipe: AirFryerPresetRecipe
    ) -> dict[str, int | str | bool | dict]:
        """Build the startCook data values from a recipe."""
        cook_req: dict[str, int | str | bool | dict] = {}
        cook_req['accountId'] = self.manager.account_id
        if recipe.preheat_time is not None and recipe.preheat_time > 0:
            cook_req['hasPreheat'] = int(True)
        cook_req['hasWarm'] = False
        cook_req['mode'] = recipe.cook_mode
        # readyStart False starts the cook at once; True waits for the start button.
        cook_req['readyStart'] = False
        cook_req['recipeId'] = recipe.recipe_id
        cook_req['recipeName'] = recipe.recipe_name
        cook_req['recipeType'] = recipe.recipe_type
        cook_req['tempUnit'] = self.temp_unit.code
        cook_req['startAct'] = {
            'cookSetTime': self.convert_time_for_api(recipe.cook_time),
            'cookTemp': recipe.target_temp,
            'preheatTemp': recipe.target_temp if recipe.preheat_time else 0,
            'shakeTime': 0,
        }
        return cook_req

    def _build_cook_request(self, recipe: AirFryerPresetRecipe) -> RequestBaseModel:
        return models.FryerTurboBlazeRequestData.from_dict(
            self._cook_request_dict(recipe)
        )

    async def get_details(self) -> None:
        resp = await self.call_bypassv2_api(
            payload_method='getAirfryerStatus',
            payload_update=self._payload_update(),
        )
        resp_model = process_bypassv2_result(
            self,
            logger,
            'get_details',
            resp,
            models.FryerTurboBlazeDetailResult,
        )

        if resp_model is None:
            return

        # Standby responses report the unit too (P583S-KUS capture).
        if resp_model.tempUnit:
            self.temp_unit = resp_model.tempUnit

        if (
            resp_model.cookStatus == AirFryerCookStatus.STANDBY.value
            or not resp_model.stepArray
        ):
            self.state.set_standby()
            return

        if resp_model.cookStatus not in self.status_map:
            logger.warning(
                'Unknown cook status %s for %s, keeping the last state',
                resp_model.cookStatus,
                self.device_name,
            )
            return

        if not 0 <= resp_model.stepIndex < len(resp_model.stepArray):
            logger.warning(
                'stepIndex %s out of range for %s steps on %s, keeping the last state',
                resp_model.stepIndex,
                len(resp_model.stepArray),
                self.device_name,
            )
            return

        cook_step = resp_model.stepArray[resp_model.stepIndex]

        # currentTemp from the bypassV2 getAirfryerStatus response is the
        # device's hardware sensor reading, which the firmware always
        # reports in Celsius regardless of the reported tempUnit. The
        # tempUnit field governs only the echoed cookTemp/preheatTemp
        # values. Normalize so consumers can compare cook_temp and
        # current_temp without a unit-aware crutch.
        _current_temp = resp_model.currentTemp
        if _current_temp is not None and self.temp_unit == TemperatureUnits.FAHRENHEIT:
            _current_temp = round(
                TemperatureUnits.to_fahrenheit(_current_temp, TemperatureUnits.CELSIUS)
            )

        self.state_chamber_1.set_state(
            cook_status=self.status_map[resp_model.cookStatus],
            cook_time=cook_step.cookSetTime,
            cook_last_time=cook_step.cookLastTime,
            cook_temp=cook_step.cookTemp,
            cook_mode=cook_step.mode,
            # preheatSetTime is 0 when the cook has no preheat step.
            preheat_set_time=resp_model.preheatSetTime or None,
            preheat_last_time=resp_model.preheatLastTime,
            current_temp=_current_temp,
            recipe=cook_step.recipeName or None,
            total_last_time=resp_model.totalTimeRemaining,
        )

    async def end(
        self, chamber: AirFryerChamber | int = AirFryerChamber.CHAMBER_1
    ) -> bool:
        if self._validate_chamber(chamber) is None:
            return False
        payload_method = 'endCook'
        resp = await self.call_bypassv2_api(
            payload_method=payload_method,
            payload_update=self._payload_update(),
        )
        r = Helpers.process_dev_response(logger, 'end', self, resp)
        if r is None:
            return False
        self.state.set_standby()
        return True

    async def set_mode_from_recipe(
        self,
        recipe: AirFryerPresetRecipe,
        *,
        chamber: AirFryerChamber | int = AirFryerChamber.CHAMBER_1,
    ) -> bool:
        if self._validate_chamber(chamber) is None:
            return False
        prepared = self._prepare_recipe(recipe)
        if prepared is None:
            return False
        recipe = prepared
        payload_method = 'startCook'
        data = self._build_cook_request(recipe)
        resp = await self.call_bypassv2_api(
            payload_method=payload_method,
            data=data.to_dict(),
            payload_update=self._payload_update(),
        )
        r = Helpers.process_dev_response(logger, 'set_mode_from_recipe', self, resp)
        if r is None:
            return False
        cook_time = self.convert_time_for_api(recipe.cook_time)
        preheat_time = (
            self.convert_time_for_api(recipe.preheat_time)
            if recipe.preheat_time
            else None
        )
        self.state.set_state(
            # A program with preheat runs the preheat phase first.
            cook_status=AirFryerCookStatus.HEATING
            if preheat_time
            else AirFryerCookStatus.COOKING,
            cook_time=cook_time,
            cook_last_time=cook_time,
            cook_temp=recipe.target_temp,
            cook_mode=recipe.cook_mode,
            preheat_set_time=preheat_time,
            preheat_last_time=preheat_time,
        )
        return True

    async def set_mode(
        self,
        cook_time: int,
        cook_temp: int,
        *,
        temp_unit: TemperatureUnits | str | None = None,
        preheat_time: int | None = None,
        cook_mode: str | None = None,
        chamber: AirFryerChamber | int = AirFryerChamber.CHAMBER_1,
    ) -> bool:
        unit = self._resolve_temp_unit(temp_unit)
        if unit is None:
            return False
        recipe = self._recipe_for_set_mode(
            cook_time, cook_temp, cook_mode, preheat_time, temp_unit=unit
        )
        if recipe is None:
            return False
        return await self.set_mode_from_recipe(recipe, chamber=chamber)

        # preheatSetTime is 0 when the cook has no preheat step.
        preheat_set_time=resp_model.preheatSetTime or None,

        current_temp=_current_temp,
        recipe=cook_step.recipeName or None,

    async def end(
    self, chamber: AirFryerChamber | int = AirFryerChamber.CHAMBER_1
) -> bool:
    if self._validate_chamber(chamber) is None:
        return False
    payload_method = 'endCook'
    resp = await self.call_bypassv2_api(
        payload_method=payload_method,
        payload_update=self._payload_update(),
    )
    r = Helpers.process_dev_response(logger, 'end', self, resp)
    if r is None:
        return False
    self.state.set_standby()
    return True

    async def set_mode_from_recipe(
    self,
    recipe: AirFryerPresetRecipe,
    *,
    chamber: AirFryerChamber | int = AirFryerChamber.CHAMBER_1,
) -> bool:
    if self._validate_chamber(chamber) is None:
        return False
    prepared = self._prepare_recipe(recipe)
    if prepared is None:
        return False
    recipe = prepared
    payload_method = 'startCook'
    data = self._build_cook_request(recipe)
    resp = await self.call_bypassv2_api(
        payload_method=payload_method,
        data=data.to_dict(),
        payload_update=self._payload_update(),
    )
    r = Helpers.process_dev_response(logger, 'set_mode_from_recipe', self, resp)
    if r is None:
        return False
    cook_time = self.convert_time_for_api(recipe.cook_time)
    preheat_time = (
        self.convert_time_for_api(recipe.preheat_time)
        if recipe.preheat_time
        else None
    )
    self.state.set_state(
        # A program with preheat runs the preheat phase first.
        cook_status=AirFryerCookStatus.HEATING
        if preheat_time
        else AirFryerCookStatus.COOKING,
        cook_time=cook_time,
        cook_last_time=cook_time,
        cook_temp=recipe.target_temp,
        cook_mode=recipe.cook_mode,
        preheat_set_time=preheat_time,
        preheat_last_time=preheat_time,
    )
    return True

    async def set_mode(
    self,
    cook_time: int,
    cook_temp: int,
    *,
    temp_unit: TemperatureUnits | str | None = None,
    preheat_time: int | None = None,
    cook_mode: str | None = None,
    chamber: AirFryerChamber | int = AirFryerChamber.CHAMBER_1,
) -> bool:
    unit = self._resolve_temp_unit(temp_unit)
    if unit is None:
        return False
    recipe = self._recipe_for_set_mode(
        cook_time, cook_temp, cook_mode, preheat_time, temp_unit=unit
    )
    if recipe is None:
        return False
    return await self.set_mode_from_recipe(recipe, chamber=chamber)

    class VeSyncDualBlazeFryer(VeSyncTurboBlazeFryer):
    """Cosori Dual Blaze Air Fryer Class (CAF-P583S).

    Uses the TurboBlaze bypassV2 protocol with the request shape from the
    CAF-P583S-KUS capture (2025-05-21): ``startCook`` data uses ``accountID``
    (not ``accountId``) and sends ``hasLinkage`` False, and every payload
    carries ``subDeviceNo`` and ``subDeviceType``. The KEU variant has no
    capture and is assumed to match. The P583S has no preheat, so
    ``preheat_time`` is dropped with a debug log.
    """

    __slots__ = ()

    def _payload_update(self) -> dict | None:
        return dict(BYPASSV2_SUB_DEVICE_PAYLOAD)

    def _build_cook_request(self, recipe: AirFryerPresetRecipe) -> RequestBaseModel:
        cook_req = self._cook_request_dict(recipe)
        cook_req['accountID'] = cook_req.pop('accountId')
        cook_req['hasLinkage'] = False
        return models.FryerDualBlazeRequestData.from_dict(cook_req)

    Bases: BypassV2Mixin, VeSyncFryer

    Cosori Dual Air Fryer Class (CAF-TF101S, CAF-TF102S, CAF-DC111S).

    Chambers are selected with AirFryerChamber:

    • CHAMBER_1 / CHAMBER_2: one chamber (left/right on the TF101S/TF102S, upper/lower on the DC111S).
    • WHOLE: the merged basket with the divider removed (TwinFry models only, WHOLE_CHAMBER feature).
    • BOTH: both chambers with identical settings, sent as the app's Sync mode (workChamber 4, syncType 2: both chambers finish together).

    During a Sync cook with different times, the DC111S reports the chamber that waits to start as AirFryerCookStatus.HOLD. Its wait counts down only while the other chamber is cooking. A Sync cook with different times can only be started from the app or the fryer.

    The device has no preheat, pause, or resume API: preheat_time and a recipe's preheat_time are ignored, and stop() / resume() return False. Pausing is handled physically by pulling the basket out, which triggers a cookStop or pullOut state. Pushing the basket back in resumes cooking automatically. The status has no temperature reading, so current_temp stays None.

    Parameters:

    Name Type Description Default
    details ResponseDeviceDetailsModel

    Device details.

    		 required
    manager VeSync

    Manager class.

    		 required
    feature_map AirFryerMap

    Device feature map.

    		 required

    Name Type Description
    state_chamber_1 FryerState

    State for chamber 1 (left) or whole.
    state_chamber_2 FryerState

    State for chamber 2 (right).
    sync_chambers bool

    Read-only. True only for the app's Sync mode (syncType 2). Set by update(); a successful set_mode() / set_mode_from_recipe() sets it True for BOTH and False for any other chamber, and end(BOTH) sets it False.
    work_chamber AirFryerChamber | None

    Read-only. Chamber the device reports as active (workChamber); None when idle. Set by update(). A successful WHOLE start sets WHOLE, any other start clears a WHOLE value, and ending WHOLE or BOTH clears it. end(CHAMBER_1) while it is WHOLE ends the whole basket.

    A failed poll leaves both chamber states unchanged, apart from the connection status and update time, which both chambers take from the response. A chamber with an unknown cookStatus keeps its state.

    class VeSyncDualAirFryer(BypassV2Mixin, VeSyncFryer):
    """Cosori Dual Air Fryer Class (CAF-TF101S, CAF-TF102S, CAF-DC111S).

    Chambers are selected with ``AirFryerChamber``:

    - ``CHAMBER_1`` / ``CHAMBER_2``: one chamber (left/right on the
      TF101S/TF102S, upper/lower on the DC111S).
    - ``WHOLE``: the merged basket with the divider removed (TwinFry models
      only, ``WHOLE_CHAMBER`` feature).
    - ``BOTH``: both chambers with identical settings, sent as the app's Sync
      mode (``workChamber`` 4, ``syncType`` 2: both chambers finish together).

    During a Sync cook with different times, the DC111S reports the chamber
    that waits to start as ``AirFryerCookStatus.HOLD``. Its wait counts down
    only while the other chamber is cooking. A Sync cook with different
    times can only be started from the app or the fryer.

    The device has no preheat, pause, or resume API: ``preheat_time`` and a
    recipe's ``preheat_time`` are ignored, and ``stop()`` / ``resume()``
    return False. Pausing is handled physically by pulling the basket out,
    which triggers a ``cookStop`` or ``pullOut`` state. Pushing the basket
    back in resumes cooking automatically. The status has no temperature
    reading, so ``current_temp`` stays None.

    Args:
        details (ResponseDeviceDetailsModel): Device details.
        manager (VeSync): Manager class.
        feature_map (AirFryerMap): Device feature map.

    Attributes:
        state_chamber_1 (FryerState): State for chamber 1 (left) or whole.
        state_chamber_2 (FryerState): State for chamber 2 (right).
        sync_chambers (bool): Read-only. True only for the app's Sync mode
            (``syncType`` 2). Set by ``update()``; a successful
            ``set_mode()`` / ``set_mode_from_recipe()`` sets it True for
            ``BOTH`` and False for any other chamber, and ``end(BOTH)`` sets
            it False.
        work_chamber (AirFryerChamber | None): Read-only. Chamber the device
            reports as active (``workChamber``); None when idle. Set by
            ``update()``. A successful ``WHOLE`` start sets ``WHOLE``, any other
            start clears a ``WHOLE`` value, and ending ``WHOLE`` or ``BOTH``
            clears it. ``end(CHAMBER_1)`` while it is ``WHOLE`` ends the whole
            basket.

    A failed poll leaves both chamber states unchanged, apart from the
    connection status and update time, which both chambers take from the
    response. A chamber with an unknown ``cookStatus`` keeps its state.
    """

    __slots__ = ()

    def _get_sync_type(self, chamber: AirFryerChamber) -> AirFryerSyncType:
        """Return the API syncType value for a validated chamber."""
        if chamber == AirFryerChamber.BOTH:
            return AirFryerSyncType.SYNC
        return AirFryerSyncType.OFF

    def _set_reported_sync(self, value: bool) -> None:
        """Set ``sync_chambers`` on both chamber states."""
        self.state_chamber_1.sync_chambers = value
        self.state_chamber_2.sync_chambers = value

    def _set_reported_work_chamber(self, value: AirFryerChamber | None) -> None:
        """Set ``work_chamber`` on both chamber states."""
        self.state_chamber_1.work_chamber = value
        self.state_chamber_2.work_chamber = value

    async def get_details(self) -> None:
        """Get device details from the API.

        Polls ``getAirfryerMultiStatus`` and updates state for each chamber.
        """
        resp = await self.call_bypassv2_api(
            payload_method='getAirfryerMultiStatus',
            payload_update=dict(BYPASSV2_SUB_DEVICE_PAYLOAD),
        )
        resp_model = process_bypassv2_result(
            self,
            logger,
            'get_details',
            resp,
            models.FryerDualMultiStatusResult,
        )

        # process_bypassv2_result only updates self.state (chamber 1).
        self.state_chamber_2.last_update_ts = self.state_chamber_1.last_update_ts
        self.state_chamber_2.connection_status = self.state_chamber_1.connection_status
        if resp_model is None:
            return

        if resp_model.tempUnit is not None:
            self.temp_unit = resp_model.tempUnit

        # Update sync state and active chamber from API response
        self._set_reported_sync(resp_model.syncType == AirFryerSyncType.SYNC)
        try:
            self._set_reported_work_chamber(AirFryerChamber(resp_model.workChamber))
        except ValueError:
            if resp_model.workChamber != 0:
                logger.debug(
                    'Unknown workChamber %s for %s',
                    resp_model.workChamber,
                    self.device_name,
                )
            self._set_reported_work_chamber(None)

        # Track which chambers were updated
        updated_chambers: set[AirFryerChamber] = set()

        for status_item in resp_model.statusList:
            ch = self._apply_chamber_status(status_item)
            if ch is not None:
                updated_chambers.add(ch)

        # Set any chambers not in the response to standby. Whole-chamber
        # status is reported as a single chamber 3 item, so chamber 2 idles.
        if (
            AirFryerChamber.CHAMBER_1 not in updated_chambers
            and AirFryerChamber.WHOLE not in updated_chambers
        ):
            self.state_chamber_1.set_standby()
        if AirFryerChamber.CHAMBER_2 not in updated_chambers:
            self.state_chamber_2.set_standby()

        self._pause_held_chamber(self.state_chamber_1, self.state_chamber_2)
        self._pause_held_chamber(self.state_chamber_2, self.state_chamber_1)

    @staticmethod
    def _pause_held_chamber(held: FryerState, other: FryerState) -> None:
        """Stop a held chamber's countdown while the other chamber is not cooking.

        During a Sync cook the held chamber's wait is the other chamber's
        remaining time minus its own cook time, so it only advances while the
        other chamber cooks (DC111S captures: the wait stays put while the
        other chamber is in ``cookStop``).
        """
        if (
            held.cook_status == AirFryerCookStatus.HOLD
            and other.cook_status != AirFryerCookStatus.COOKING
        ):
            held.last_timestamp = None

    def _apply_chamber_status(
        self, status_item: models.FryerDualChamberStatusItem
    ) -> AirFryerChamber | None:
        """Update one chamber's state from a ``statusList`` item.

        A chamber with an unknown ``cookStatus`` keeps its last state but still
        counts as reported.

        Args:
            status_item (models.FryerDualChamberStatusItem): The status item.

        Returns:
            AirFryerChamber | None: The reported chamber, or None (after a
            warning) if the chamber number is unknown.
        """
        chamber_state = self.get_chamber_state(status_item.chamber)
        if chamber_state is None:
            logger.warning(
                'Unknown chamber %s in status for %s',
                status_item.chamber,
                self.device_name,
            )
            return None
        ch = AirFryerChamber(status_item.chamber)
        if status_item.cookStatus not in self.status_map:
            logger.warning(
                'Unknown cook status %s for %s chamber %d, keeping its last state',
                status_item.cookStatus,
                self.device_name,
                status_item.chamber,
            )
        elif status_item.cookStatus == AirFryerCookStatus.STANDBY.value:
            chamber_state.set_standby()
        else:
            chamber_state.set_state(
                cook_status=self.status_map[status_item.cookStatus],
                cook_time=status_item.cookSetTime,
                cook_last_time=status_item.currentRemainingTime,
                cook_temp=status_item.cookTemp,
                cook_mode=status_item.mode,
                recipe=status_item.recipeName or None,
                total_last_time=status_item.totalTimeRemaining,
            )
        return ch

    async def end(
        self, chamber: AirFryerChamber | int = AirFryerChamber.CHAMBER_1
    ) -> bool:
        """End the current cooking session.

        Args:
            chamber (AirFryerChamber | int): Chamber to end. ``BOTH`` ends
                both chambers. ``CHAMBER_1`` during a whole-basket cook
                (``work_chamber`` ``WHOLE``) ends the whole basket. During a
                Sync cook (``sync_chambers``), one chamber sends an end for
                that chamber only.

        Returns:
            bool: True on success, and the ended chamber state(s) are set to
            standby. False without a request for an unsupported chamber.
        """
        member = self._validate_chamber(chamber)
        if member is None:
            return False
        if (
            member == AirFryerChamber.CHAMBER_1
            and self.work_chamber == AirFryerChamber.WHOLE
        ):
            logger.debug(
                '%s is cooking in the whole basket; ending WHOLE', self.device_name
            )
            member = AirFryerChamber.WHOLE
        if self.sync_chambers and member in (
            AirFryerChamber.CHAMBER_1,
            AirFryerChamber.CHAMBER_2,
        ):
            logger.debug(
                '%s is in Sync mode; end(%s) ends one chamber, '
                'pass AirFryerChamber.BOTH to end both',
                self.device_name,
                member.name,
            )
        resp = await self.call_bypassv2_api(
            payload_method='endCook',
            data={'chamber': int(member)},
            payload_update=dict(BYPASSV2_SUB_DEVICE_PAYLOAD),
        )
        r = Helpers.process_dev_response(logger, 'end', self, resp)
        if r is None:
            return False

        if member == AirFryerChamber.BOTH:
            self.state_chamber_1.set_standby()
            self.state_chamber_2.set_standby()
            self._set_reported_sync(False)
        else:
            self._chamber_state(member).set_standby()
        if member in (AirFryerChamber.WHOLE, AirFryerChamber.BOTH):
            self._set_reported_work_chamber(None)
        return True

    def _build_cook_configs(
        self,
        recipe: AirFryerPresetRecipe,
        chamber: AirFryerChamber,
    ) -> list[models.FryerDualCookConfig]:
        """Build cookConfigs list for startMultiCook request.

        Args:
            recipe: The recipe to cook.
            chamber: Validated chamber. ``BOTH`` gives configs for chambers
                1 and 2.

        Returns:
            List of FryerDualCookConfig for the API request.
        """
        config_dict = {
            'cookSetTime': self.convert_time_for_api(recipe.cook_time),
            'cookTemp': recipe.target_temp,
            'mode': recipe.cook_mode,
            'recipeId': recipe.recipe_id,
            'recipeName': recipe.recipe_name,
            'recipeType': recipe.recipe_type,
        }

        if chamber == AirFryerChamber.BOTH:
            return [
                models.FryerDualCookConfig.from_dict({**config_dict, 'chamber': 1}),
                models.FryerDualCookConfig.from_dict({**config_dict, 'chamber': 2}),
            ]
        return [
            models.FryerDualCookConfig.from_dict(
                {**config_dict, 'chamber': int(chamber)}
            ),
        ]

    async def set_mode_from_recipe(
        self,
        recipe: AirFryerPresetRecipe,
        *,
        chamber: AirFryerChamber | int = AirFryerChamber.CHAMBER_1,
    ) -> bool:
        """Start cooking with a preset recipe.

        Args:
            recipe: The preset recipe to use. Its ``preheat_time`` is ignored.
            chamber (AirFryerChamber | int): Chamber to cook in. ``BOTH``
                cooks both chambers in sync.

        Returns:
            True if the command was successful.
        """
        member = self._validate_chamber(chamber)
        if member is None:
            return False
        prepared = self._prepare_recipe(recipe)
        if prepared is None:
            return False
        recipe = prepared
        cook_configs = self._build_cook_configs(recipe, member)

        start_data = models.FryerDualStartCookData.from_dict(
            {
                'accountId': self.manager.account_id,
                'cookConfigs': [c.to_dict() for c in cook_configs],
                # readyStart False starts the cook at once; True waits for the
                # start button.
                'readyStart': False,
                'syncType': int(self._get_sync_type(member)),
                'tempUnit': self.temp_unit.code,
                'workChamber': int(member),
            }
        )

        resp = await self.call_bypassv2_api(
            payload_method='startMultiCook',
            data=start_data.to_dict(),
            payload_update=dict(BYPASSV2_SUB_DEVICE_PAYLOAD),
        )
        r = Helpers.process_dev_response(logger, 'set_mode_from_recipe', self, resp)
        if r is None:
            return False

        # Update state for affected chambers
        both = member == AirFryerChamber.BOTH
        chambers = (
            [self.state_chamber_1, self.state_chamber_2]
            if both
            else [self._chamber_state(member)]
        )
        self._set_reported_sync(both)
        if member == AirFryerChamber.WHOLE:
            self._set_reported_work_chamber(AirFryerChamber.WHOLE)
        elif self.work_chamber == AirFryerChamber.WHOLE:
            self._set_reported_work_chamber(None)
        cook_time = self.convert_time_for_api(recipe.cook_time)
        for ch_state in chambers:
            # readyStart is False, so the cook starts without the start button.
            ch_state.set_state(
                cook_status=AirFryerCookStatus.COOKING,
                cook_time=cook_time,
                cook_last_time=cook_time,
                cook_temp=recipe.target_temp,
                cook_mode=recipe.cook_mode,
                recipe=recipe.recipe_name,
            )
        return True

    async def set_mode(
        self,
        cook_time: int,
        cook_temp: int,
        *,
        temp_unit: TemperatureUnits | str | None = None,
        preheat_time: int | None = None,
        cook_mode: str | None = None,
        chamber: AirFryerChamber | int = AirFryerChamber.CHAMBER_1,
    ) -> bool:
        """Set cooking mode with manual parameters.

        Args:
            cook_time: Cooking time in seconds.
            cook_temp: Cooking temperature, in ``temp_unit``.
            temp_unit: Unit of ``cook_temp``; defaults to the device's
                current ``temp_unit``. An unrecognised unit string returns
                False without a request.
            preheat_time: Not used for this device.
            cook_mode: Cook mode, an ``AirFryerCookModes`` key or the API
                mode string (e.g. 'AirFry'). None uses the default preset.
            chamber (AirFryerChamber | int): Chamber to cook in. ``BOTH``
                cooks both chambers in sync.

        Returns:
            True if the command was successful.
        """
        del preheat_time  # not supported by this device
        unit = self._resolve_temp_unit(temp_unit)
        if unit is None:
            return False
        recipe = self._recipe_for_set_mode(
            cook_time, cook_temp, cook_mode, None, temp_unit=unit
        )
        if recipe is None:
            return False
        return await self.set_mode_from_recipe(recipe, chamber=chamber)

    async def get_details(self) -> None:
    """Get device details from the API.

    Polls ``getAirfryerMultiStatus`` and updates state for each chamber.
    """
    resp = await self.call_bypassv2_api(
        payload_method='getAirfryerMultiStatus',
        payload_update=dict(BYPASSV2_SUB_DEVICE_PAYLOAD),
    )
    resp_model = process_bypassv2_result(
        self,
        logger,
        'get_details',
        resp,
        models.FryerDualMultiStatusResult,
    )

    # process_bypassv2_result only updates self.state (chamber 1).
    self.state_chamber_2.last_update_ts = self.state_chamber_1.last_update_ts
    self.state_chamber_2.connection_status = self.state_chamber_1.connection_status
    if resp_model is None:
        return

    if resp_model.tempUnit is not None:
        self.temp_unit = resp_model.tempUnit

    # Update sync state and active chamber from API response
    self._set_reported_sync(resp_model.syncType == AirFryerSyncType.SYNC)
    try:
        self._set_reported_work_chamber(AirFryerChamber(resp_model.workChamber))
    except ValueError:
        if resp_model.workChamber != 0:
            logger.debug(
                'Unknown workChamber %s for %s',
                resp_model.workChamber,
                self.device_name,
            )
        self._set_reported_work_chamber(None)

    # Track which chambers were updated
    updated_chambers: set[AirFryerChamber] = set()

    for status_item in resp_model.statusList:
        ch = self._apply_chamber_status(status_item)
        if ch is not None:
            updated_chambers.add(ch)

    # Set any chambers not in the response to standby. Whole-chamber
    # status is reported as a single chamber 3 item, so chamber 2 idles.
    if (
        AirFryerChamber.CHAMBER_1 not in updated_chambers
        and AirFryerChamber.WHOLE not in updated_chambers
    ):
        self.state_chamber_1.set_standby()
    if AirFryerChamber.CHAMBER_2 not in updated_chambers:
        self.state_chamber_2.set_standby()

    self._pause_held_chamber(self.state_chamber_1, self.state_chamber_2)
    self._pause_held_chamber(self.state_chamber_2, self.state_chamber_1)

    async def end(
    self, chamber: AirFryerChamber | int = AirFryerChamber.CHAMBER_1
) -> bool:
    """End the current cooking session.

    Args:
        chamber (AirFryerChamber | int): Chamber to end. ``BOTH`` ends
            both chambers. ``CHAMBER_1`` during a whole-basket cook
            (``work_chamber`` ``WHOLE``) ends the whole basket. During a
            Sync cook (``sync_chambers``), one chamber sends an end for
            that chamber only.

    Returns:
        bool: True on success, and the ended chamber state(s) are set to
        standby. False without a request for an unsupported chamber.
    """
    member = self._validate_chamber(chamber)
    if member is None:
        return False
    if (
        member == AirFryerChamber.CHAMBER_1
        and self.work_chamber == AirFryerChamber.WHOLE
    ):
        logger.debug(
            '%s is cooking in the whole basket; ending WHOLE', self.device_name
        )
        member = AirFryerChamber.WHOLE
    if self.sync_chambers and member in (
        AirFryerChamber.CHAMBER_1,
        AirFryerChamber.CHAMBER_2,
    ):
        logger.debug(
            '%s is in Sync mode; end(%s) ends one chamber, '
            'pass AirFryerChamber.BOTH to end both',
            self.device_name,
            member.name,
        )
    resp = await self.call_bypassv2_api(
        payload_method='endCook',
        data={'chamber': int(member)},
        payload_update=dict(BYPASSV2_SUB_DEVICE_PAYLOAD),
    )
    r = Helpers.process_dev_response(logger, 'end', self, resp)
    if r is None:
        return False

    if member == AirFryerChamber.BOTH:
        self.state_chamber_1.set_standby()
        self.state_chamber_2.set_standby()
        self._set_reported_sync(False)
    else:
        self._chamber_state(member).set_standby()
    if member in (AirFryerChamber.WHOLE, AirFryerChamber.BOTH):
        self._set_reported_work_chamber(None)
    return True

    pyvesync.base_devices.fryer_base.FryerState ↲

    Bases: DeviceState

    State class for Air Fryer devices.

    Each FryerState instance represents a single cooking chamber. For single chamber fryers, state is set to state_chamber_1. For dual chamber fryers, state_chamber_1 and state_chamber_2 are used independently.

    Times are in SECONDS, whatever the device's API uses; set_state() converts API values with the device's convert_time_for_state(). Temperatures are in the device's temp_unit.

    Parameters:

    Name Type Description Default
    device VeSyncFryer

    The device object.

    		 required
    details ResponseDeviceDetailsModel

    The device details.

    		 required
    feature_map AirFryerMap

    The feature map for the device.

    		 required

    Attributes:

    Name Type Description
    active_time int

    Active time of device, defaults to None.
    connection_status str

    Connection status of device.
    device VeSyncFryer

    Device object.
    device_status str

    Device status.
    features list[str]

    AirFryerFeatures values from the device map.
    time_units TimeUnits

    The time unit of the device's API. State times are always in seconds.
    cook_status AirFryerCookStatus | None

    The current cooking status.
    cook_mode str | None

    The API mode string of the current cook (for example 'AirFry' or 'poultry'), not an AirFryerCookModes key.
    temp_unit TemperatureUnits

    Unit for all temperatures in this state (read-through to the device's temp_unit).
    current_temp int | None

    The current temperature in temp_unit units.
    cook_set_temp int | None

    The set cooking temperature in temp_unit units.
    cook_set_time int | None

    The set cooking time in seconds.
    cook_last_time int | None

    The remaining cooking time in seconds at the last update or command. cook_time_remaining counts it down.
    last_timestamp datetime | None

    When the remaining times were last refreshed. Set each time cook_status is set to cooking, heating or hold (each update while running), None after standby, a stop, or a HOLD poll while the other chamber is not cooking. Used to count the remaining times down.
    preheat_set_time int | None

    The set preheating time in seconds.
    preheat_last_time int | None

    The remaining preheating time in seconds at the last update or command. preheat_time_remaining counts it down.
    total_last_time int | None

    Device-reported total remaining time (preheat plus cook) in seconds at the last update; None when the device does not report it (CS158) or after a local command until the next update.
    recipe str | None

    The recipe name the device reports. A local command sets it only on dual-chamber fryers.
    ready_start bool

    Not used by the library; always False.
    sync_chambers bool

    True only when the device reports the app's Sync mode (syncType 2). Dual-chamber fryers only, always False otherwise: set by update(), by a successful set_mode() / set_mode_from_recipe() (True only for BOTH) and by end(BOTH) (False). The same on both chamber states.
    work_chamber AirFryerChamber | None

    Chamber the device reports as active (workChamber); None when idle or not reported, and always None on single-chamber fryers. Set by update(); a successful WHOLE start sets it to WHOLE, any other start clears a WHOLE value, and ending WHOLE or BOTH clears it. The same on both chamber states.
    Note

    Device classes call set_state() with the API response or the sent request, set_standby() to clear the state, and the stop and resume helpers for local pause and resume. Setting a running cook_status (cooking, heating or hold) updates last_timestamp. A failed or unreadable poll leaves the state unchanged.
